responsibility: Public intrinsic header for the LoongArch LASX 256-bit SIMD extension. It declares the LASX vector typedefs and __m256/__m256i/__m256d interfaces, then exposes user-facing inline wrappers and macros that map C/C++ intrinsic calls onto __builtin_lasx_* builtins with the required vector types and immediate constraints, providing the source-level programming interface to LASX instructions.
